name: superbee-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Superbee, a minimal, filesystem-first OKF knowledge store. The publishable successor artifact is the `superbee` CLI (packages/cli), which bundles core, the reference server, and UI assets.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @superbee/core -w @superbee/board-git -w @superbee/server -w @superbee/view-runtime -w @superbee/ui-server -w @superbee/markdown-renderer -w @superbee/mcp-app -w @superbee/publication && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:scripts: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/package-core-external-proof.test.mjs scripts/package-server-external-proof.test.mjs scripts/oss-hosted-boundary.test.mjs scripts/verify-npm-package.test.mjs scripts/mutation-survivors.test.mjs scripts/migrate-legacy-view-names.test.mjs scripts/first-party-consumers.test.mjs scripts/ci-lanes.test.mjs scripts/aliasing-host-coverage.test.mjs scripts/workflow-ci-topology.test.mjs scripts/workflow-codeql-topology.test.mjs scripts/workflow-release-topology.test.mjs scripts/workflow-runtime-libraries-release-topology.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:npm-package && npm run check:skill -w superbee && npm run test:browser -w @superbee/mcp-app && npm run e2e:gate -w @superbee/ui
scripts.ci:runtime: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present --ignore-scripts && npm test --workspaces --if-present --ignore-scripts
scripts.ci:distribution: npm run verify:npm-package && npm run check:skill -w superbee
scripts.ci:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser -w @superbee/mcp-app && npm run e2e:gate -w @superbee/ui
scripts.ci:scripts: npm run build && npm run test:scripts
scripts.ci:aliasing-host: npm run build && npm test -w @superbee/core --ignore-scripts && npm run test:host-class -w superbee
